description: Variation of condition 2 of planning application ref: 2024/01841/FUL granted 30th January 2026 for the 'Installation of 2no VRF heat pumps to northern elevation of the building at lower ground floor level; removal of air conditioning units from main roof level'. Amendments sought to include: External alterations to comprise (1) To Main Building Elevations: Relocation of the external condenser units from the south elevation to within the building's existing bin store, removing all externally visible plant; External AC pipework from bin store to be routed from the bin store to main building via a conduit bridge, pipework running on main building elevation to be concealed within metal trunking/boxings colour matched to the elevation; (2) To External Bin Store: installation of a small lead sheet (or equivalent) dormer to the pitched roofslope and replacement of the existing painted timber solid double doorsets with factory finished metal acoustic louvred doors of the same dimension; (3) To External Areas: Installation of 2-3 lightweight timber freestanding bin cupboards within the front garden (to be located adjacent to the south boundary/party wall); associated external alterations.
